title: Green Water Aviation Air Tours
specs: Fly over Summersville Lake State Park, New River Gorge National Park, Babcock State Park, Hawks Nest State Park, Carnifex Ferry Battlefield State Park, Kanawha Falls
Children must be accompanied by an adult on airport property
Flights operated by a commercially licensed pilot
blurb: Guests take scenic flights ranging from 15 minutes to 1 hour over West Virginia's landmarks including Summersville Lake State Park, New River Gorge National Park, and others. Flights are operated by a commercially licensed pilot and aircraft are maintained according to FAA regulations. Flights are weather-dependent and can be rescheduled if conditions are unfavorable.
